findings.target: POSIX_FILE / walk / ledger and baseline schemas
findings.finding: ASCII whitelist excludes legitimate route filenames containing $, and walk silently skips them. This violates complete source coverage.
findings.required: Accept valid relative POSIX filenames including $ and spaces while rejecting absolute/traversal paths. Never silently skip invalid applicable paths; emit a blocking error. Test a src/routes/$workspaceId.tsx violation.

findings.finding: Test/story suffixes and generated paths are implicitly exempted without exact reviewed ledger entries.
findings.required: Require each exact path and boundary kind to be explicitly registered before excluding its governed findings; test an unregistered .stories.tsx and .test.tsx violation.

findings.finding: Boundary and permanent-exception filtering precedes infrastructureKind, so parse/unsupported errors can be suppressed.
findings.required: Classify and reject parse/unsupported findings before any exception or debt accounting; prove exact matching permanent exceptions and reviewed boundaries cannot silence them.

findings.finding: Missing source roots are silently ignored; wrong root can yield an empty scan.
findings.required: Default source scan must fail on missing canonical src root and invalid root; optional package roots should be explicit. Add wrong-root/empty-scan fixture.

findings.finding: Report exposes only errors and scannedFileCount, so accepted existing debt disappears from a successful audit report.
findings.required: Include current debt fingerprint counts and per-rule totals, accepted baseline debt, and applied registered exceptions. The checkpoint must report existing debt explicitly even when no new debt is introduced.
